lighting.method: static light estimate (delvec prefab, the compiler's block+sky flood): min over 145 floor cell(s) reachable on foot from 50 ground-level entry cell(s), of 145 standable in the region box; the piece stands in open air, so sky light enters through its openings. Taken at effective sky 4 (a clear night, the darkest the engine models); under full daylight (sky 15) the same minimum is 15. NOT a live-server probe; dark_threshold=3. Re-probe live for borderline pieces.
